name: Practice: Your First Pomodoro Session
equipment: A timer and one task to focus on
instructions: Pick one real task you have been putting off and set a timer for 25 minutes.
If a distracting thought pops up, jot it on a notepad to deal with later rather than acting on it now.
Take the full 5-minute break when the timer ends, away from your screen if possible.
Do a second round if the task needs it -- notice whether starting felt easier the second time.
